goodLeads: Local businesses (restaurants, clinics, salons) with high review counts but NO website URL.
Service businesses where a portfolio is critical but their digital presence relies solely on Facebook.
Businesses with strong ratings and contact info, showing they are active and likely have budget.
weakerLeads: Businesses with no phone, no email, and no website (hard to reach, low data quality).
Categories that rarely need custom websites (e.g., street kiosks, ATMs, generic corporate branches).
badLeads: Businesses that already have a functioning, modern website (unless a redesign gap is obvious).
Closed or permanently shut down businesses.
